minor.comment: Add hydration helpers for prerendered pages: `fetchRecord()` answers identical GET and HEAD requests from the page's hydration island, `replaceNonTemplateChildren()` takes `{ identity }` (from `templateIdentity()` or `htmlIdentity()`) and returns `"adopted"` when the server already rendered that source, `holdHydration()` keeps hydration open for start-up work and `whenHydrated()` resolves when it ends
Add `NO_SSR_ATTR`, the name of the `no-ssr` attribute that keeps a region of a page out of a prerender
Add `matchesKey()`, the keyboard filter behind Quark's `key:` and `keycode-filter`, which also names the space bar `Space` / `Spacebar` and the plus key `plus`
Add `resolveModuleUrl()`, and update `resolveModuleReference()` to load an absolute `http(s)` URL as it is (it prefixed the page origin) and to refuse other schemes such as `data:` and `blob:`
Update `fetchTemplate()` and `fetchPlainText()` to reject with `HTTP <status>: <url>` on an error status instead of returning the error page as content

Update `resolveTemplateContent()` and `fetchPlainText()` so `reqInit.signal` ends only that caller's wait: the shared request goes on and fills the cache, so other callers waiting on the same URL get the content (an abort used to fail them all), a time limit such as `AbortSignal.timeout(…)` no longer limits the request itself, only that wait (the uncached `fetchTemplate()` still passes its signal to `fetch`), and an already aborted signal fails at once, before any request starts

patch.comment: Fix an issue where a failed template or plain-text request stayed cached for the page: the next call fetches again
Ship only dist (and declared extras) in the npm tarball; drop build logs, tests and sources
